PcosCycleFertility.6: Xa unesifo sePCOS, umjikelo wakho unokuba mde, ungacwangciswanga yaye ngamanye amaxesha kunzima ukuwuprofeta.
PcosCycleFertility.14: Kufuneka ubonane nini nogqirha ukuba ufuna ukukhulelwa
PcosCycleFertility.16: Umjikelo wokuya esikhathini uxhomekeke kumlinganiselo ohlanganisiweyo weempawu zehomoni.
PcosCycleFertility.17: Amaqanda anokuqulatha amaqunube amancinane amaninzi aqalisa ukuvela ngaphandle kokuba amaqunube aphambili afikelele ekuvuthweni rhoqo.
PcosCycleFertility.18: Esi sesinye sezizathu zokuba abanye abantu abane-PCOS babe nemijikelo emi-35, emi-45, okanye maxa wambi emihlanu, ngoxa abanye benokuba nemijikelo emifutshane nobude obuqhelekileyo.
PcosCycleFertility.20: Ubude bomjikelo ngokwawo abukuxeleli ukuba kwenzeka na ukuqhuma kwamaqanda.
PcosCycleFertility.22: Kwisigaba esiqhelekileyo, ukuvuthwa kwamaqanda kuhlala kusondele kumlinganiselo ophakathi. Kodwa kwi-PCOS, lo mthetho uselula awusoloko usebenza.
PcosCycleFertility.24: Xa ukuvuthwa kwamaqanda kungenakubonwa kwangaphambili, kuba nzima ukuqikelela ukuba uyazala njani xa kusekelwe kumhla wokuya esikhathini.
PcosCycleFertility.25: Kukho iimpawu ezininzi zomzimba ezinokuhambisana notshintsho lwehomoni olujikeleze ukuqhuma kwamaqanda.
PcosCycleFertility.26: Utshintsho kumthambo womzimba womntwana, onokuba mninzi, ucace ngakumbi yaye unokutyhala
PcosCycleFertility.27: Intlungu encinane okanye ukungakhululeki kwibhinqa elithile
PcosCycleFertility.30: Ukunyuka okunokwenzeka kwe libido kwabanye abafazi
PcosCycleFertility.31: I-cervical mucus iyamangalisa kuba njengoko i-fertile window isondela, inokuba yande, icace, ibe ne-slippery, yaye inokuqina.
PcosCycleFertility.33: Xa kukho imijikelo engekho mgangathweni, umhla wokuqhawula amadlala obalwe ngokuzenzekelayo kwimijikelo yangaphambili unokuba ngumlinganiselo ofanelekileyo.
PcosCycleFertility.34: I-PCOS ingenza ukuba ukukhulelwa kube nzima ngakumbi, ingakumbi xa ukuvuthwa kweqanda kungaqhelekanga okanye kunzima ukuyicinga.
PcosCycleFertility.35: Abanye abafazi abane-PCOS bafumana amaqanda rhoqo baze bakhulelwe ngaphandle kobunzima obukhulu, ngoxa abanye befumana amaqanda angekho mgangathweni ngokwaneleyo ukuze kufuneke baxutyushwe baze mhlawumbi banyanyekelwe.
PcosCycleFertility.37: Eyona ngxaki iphambili kukugqitywa kweqanda ngokungalunganga okanye okungalindelekanga
PcosCycleFertility.38: Ukuqhomfa kunokwenzeka naxa imijikelo imide kakhulu
PcosCycleFertility.39: Ukunyamekela ngendlela efanelekileyo kunokuphucula amathuba okuzala
PcosCycleFertility.40: Uhambo lokuzala luxhomekeke kumntu ngamnye nakwezinye izinto ezininzi
PcosCycleFertility.41: Ukuzala akuxhomekekanga ekuqhomeni kweqanda kuphela. Ubudala, umgangatho wesidoda, imeko yemibhobho ye-fallopian, i-endometrium, nezinye izinto nazo zinokuba nendima. Kungenxa yoko le nto ukuvavanywa okupheleleyo kubalulekile xa ukukhulelwa kuthatha ixesha elide kunokuba bekulindelekile.
PcosCycleFertility.42: Iinkqubo zokulandelela ixesha ngokuqhelekileyo zisebenzisa idatha evela kwimijikelo yangaphambili ukuvelisa uqikelelo. Xa imijikelezo ihlala ihleli, ezi uqikelelo zinokuba luncedo njengesalathiso.
PcosCycleFertility.43: Kodwa xa kukho i-PCOS, ukungaguquguquki kwemijikelezo kunokwenza ukubala kungabi semthethweni.
PcosCycleFertility.45: Ukulandelela kwedijithali kuluncedo kakhulu ekuboneni izikhokelo kumjikelo wakho kwaye ugcine imbali yokwabelana nomnikezeli wakho wezempilo.
PcosCycleFertility.46: Ukulandelelana rhoqo kunokukunceda uqonde ngcono iinguqu zakho.
PcosCycleFertility.47: Phawula umhla wosuku lokuqala lwentshukumo nganye, nokuba ngaba imijikelezo ihamba kakhulu
PcosCycleFertility.48: Ukujonga utshintsho kwi- cervical mucus ngexesha lonke lomjikelo
PcosCycleFertility.49: Phawula naziphi na iintlungu ezisezantsi okanye ezinye iimpawu ezinokuhambisana nokuqhomfa
PcosCycleFertility.50: Kuphephe ukuthembela kuphela kumlinganiselo weentsuku ezingama-28 ukuze uqikelele ukuqhuma kwamaqanda
PcosCycleFertility.51: Sebenzisa iimvavanyo zokuqhomfa ngenyameko uze, ukuba kuyimfuneko, ucele ingcebiso kwiingcali
PcosCycleFertility.52: Yabelana ngolwazi oluqokelelweyo negqirha ukuba ufuna ukukhulelwa
PcosCycleFertility.53: Kwakhona kunokukunceda ukwazi iimpawu ezihambelana nalo: iintlungu, i-acne, utshintsho kumzimba womzimba, ukopha okungaqhelekanga, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, okanye ezinye izinto ezibonakala kuwe.
PcosCycleFertility.54: Ukuqhagamshelana naye kunokuba luncedo nangaphambi kokuba uqale ukuzama ukukhulelwa, xa imijikelezo ingekho ngcembe, ikhawuleze kakhulu, okanye xa ixesha lokuya esikhathini lingekho ixesha elide.
PcosCycleFertility.55: Ingcali yezempilo inokuhlolisisa izizathu zokungabikho kokungalunganga, ihlole ukuqhuma kwamaqanda ize, ukuba kuyimfuneko, icebise indlela efanelekileyo yokuzilungiselela ukukhulelwa.
PcosCycleFertility.57: Ukuba ixesha lakho lokuya esikhathini liphakathi, ukuba ungazange ube nalo kangangeenyanga eziliqela, okanye ukuba ukukhulelwa akuveli nangona unesondo rhoqo, thetha nogqirha wakho.
PcosCycleFertility.59: I-PCOS inokwenza imijikelezo ibe mide yaye ingaqikelelwanga.
PcosCycleFertility.60: Ukuqhomfa kusenokuba kukungaqhelekanga okanye kungabikho kwezinye iintsuku.
PcosCycleFertility.61: Umjikelo ongekho mthethweni awuthethi ngokuzenzekelayo ukungabikho kokuzala.
PcosCycleFertility.62: Ukuqikelela okusekelwe kwikhalenda kuphela kusenokuba yinto enokuthenjwa kancinane kwi-PCOS.
PcosCycleFertility.63: Ukujonga umjikelo wakho nokugcina imbali kunokukunceda, ngokukodwa xa uthetha.
PcosCycleFertility.65: I-PCOS ayiveli ngendlela efanayo kuwo onke amabhinqa. Umjikelo wakho unokutshintsha ngokuhamba kwexesha.
PcosCycleFertility.66: Eli nqaku linenjongo yolwazi nolwazi kuphela.

PcosDiagnosis.6: Indlela yokufumanisa ukuba une-PCOS, yintoni enokuxilongwa ngayo, nendlela yokulungiselela ngokuzolileyo ixesha lakho.
PcosDiagnosis.15: Ukuxilongwa kwe-polycystic ovary syndrome akuxhomekekanga kuvavanyo olunye.
PcosDiagnosis.16: Injongo kukujonga iimpawu ezihambelana nePCOS nokugxotha ezinye izizathu ezinokuchaza amaxesha okungahambi kakuhle okanye iimpawu ezithile zehomoni.
PcosDiagnosis.18: Ukuxilongwa kusoloko kuyinto eyenziwe ngumntu ngamnye. Abafazi ababini abane-PCOS banokuba neempawu ezahlukeneyo kakhulu neziphumo zovavanyo.
PcosDiagnosis.21: Lo mqeqeshi uhlanganisa imbali yakho: imijikelezo, iimpawu, imvelaphi yezonyango, kunye nonyango.
PcosDiagnosis.23: Ngokukodwa, zikhangela iimpawu zeandrogens ezingaphezulu yaye zivavanye imeko yakho ngokubanzi.
PcosDiagnosis.25: Ukucaciswa kwemeko kunokucelwa ukuba kuhlolwe iihomoni kunye neemetabolic.
PcosDiagnosis.33: Uvavanyo lwegazi lunokufunyaniswa ukuze kukhangelwe iimpawu zeandrogens ezingaphaya, kuhlolwe iihomoni ezithile ezibandakanyekayo ekuzaleni, kuze kukhangelwe nezinye izizathu ezinokubangela iimpawu zakho.
PcosDiagnosis.34: Utyando olukhethiweyo luxhomekeke kwiminyaka yakho, kwiimpawu zakho, kwimbali yakho yezonyango, noko kufunwa ngugqirha.
PcosDiagnosis.38: Kunceda ngokukodwa ukulahla izizathu ezithile zokujikeleza okungaqhelekanga.
PcosDiagnosis.40: Iglucose yegazi, ngamanye amaxesha iphaneli yelipid kuxhomekeke kwizinto ezibangela umngcipheko.
PcosDiagnosis.42: Iziphumo ze-hormonal kufuneka zichazwe kunye nomxholo wempilo.
PcosDiagnosis.43: I-ultrasound ingasetyenziselwa ukujonga ukubonakala kweesibeleko ngokukodwa ukukhangela inani elikhulu leengqungquthela ezincinane.
PcosDiagnosis.45: Ukubona iimbambo ezininzi kwi-ultra-sound akuthethi ukuba une-PCOS.
PcosDiagnosis.46: Ukufumana isifo se-PCOS akwenzi ukuba ukwazi ukuqikelela ukuba izinto ziza kuhamba njani.
PcosDiagnosis.50: Uvavanyo oluqhelekileyo lwe-ultrasound alukhathaleli ukuba i-PCOS ingabakho.
PcosDiagnosis.51: Ulwazi oluthile olulungiselelwe kwangaphambili lunokunceda umqeqeshi aqonde imbali yakho aze akhethe ezona mvavanyo zifanelekileyo.
PcosDiagnosis.53: Ngaba ukhe waqaphela ukuba kukho i-acne, ukukhula kweenwele okungaqhelekanga, okanye ukuwa kweenwele?
PcosDiagnosis.54: Ngaba kukho imbali yosapho ye-PCOS okanye isifo seswekile?
PcosDiagnosis.55: Ngaba unqwenela ukukhulelwa kwixesha elifutshane okanye eliphakathi?
PcosDiagnosis.57: Ukuba kunokwenzeka, phawula imihla yomjikelo wakho wokugqibela, ubude obuqikelelweyo bemijikelo yakho, iimpawu ozibonayo, kunye naluphi na unyango okanye izongezo ozithethayo.
PcosDiagnosis.59: Ukuxilongwa kuxhomekeke kwizinto ezininzi, kungekhona kuvavanyo olunye.
PcosDiagnosis.60: Uvavanyo lwegazi lunokukhangela ukungazinzi kwehomoni ezithile luze lukhuphe ezinye izizathu.
PcosDiagnosis.64: Uhlolisiso lwe-PCOS alululo uvavanyo olunye okanye isigwebo sokugqibela.
PcosDiagnosis.65: Eli nqaku linceda kuphela ekufundeni yaye alithathi indawo yokubonisana nogqirha okanye ukuchazwa ngokweziqu kweempendulo zakho.

PcosHormonalAcne.6: Kutheni i-acne yehomoni inokubakho kwi-PCOS, indlela yokuyibona, yaye ziziphi iindlela ezinokukunceda ukuyisingatha.
PcosHormonalAcne.7: Ichaphazela amabhinqa amaninzi yaye ayisosiphene sococeko okanye ayinto engenakuphepheka: ukuqonda imvelaphi yayo kunceda ukuyisingatha ngcono.
PcosHormonalAcne.17: I-acne ye-hormonal luhlobo lwe-acne oluxhunyaniswe ngokuthe ngqo nokutshintshana kwe-hormonal okanye ukungalingani, ngakumbi kwi-androgens. ngokungafaniyo ne-acne eqhelekileyo yolutsha, idla ngokuchaphazela amabhinqa amakhulu kwaye inokuqhubeka okanye ivele emva kwelo xesha.
PcosHormonalAcne.18: Kwakhona yahlukile kwindawo yayo, kubunzulu bayo, yaye ithambekele ekubuyeni kwiindawo ezifanayo nangona ilandelwa kakuhle indlela yokunyamekela isikhumba rhoqo.
PcosHormonalAcne.20: I-acne yehomoni ayidibani nokungacoceki: ukuhlamba ubuso rhoqo akuyi kususa, yaye kunokude kucaphukise ulusu.
PcosHormonalAcne.22: Kwi-PCOS, ukugqithisa kwe-androgens kuvuselela i- sebaceous glands, ezenza i-sebum eninzi. Ulusu olunye lukwabuthathaka ngakumbi kwezi homoni, nto leyo echaza isizathu sokuba i-acne inokuchazwa nokuba akukho ukungalingani okukhulu okulinganiswa kwilebhu.
PcosHormonalAcne.23: Oku akuxhomekekanga kumandla okufuna: loo mvakalelo iyahluka kuye komnye umntu yaye akuxhomekekanga kwindlela ophila ngayo.
PcosHormonalAcne.25: Iimpawu ezithile zihlala ziphinda zenzeke, nangona zingahambi kakuhle:
PcosHormonalAcne.31: I-acne yehomoni inokuhluka ebudeni bomjikelo. Abafazi abaninzi bayaphawula ukuqhuma kwe-acne kwiintsuku ezingaphambi kwexesha labo lokuya exesheni, xa iprogesterone inyuka ize emva koko yehle kakhulu, nto leyo eyenza ukuba kuvele i-sebum okwethutyana.
PcosHormonalAcne.33: Ukuqaphela xa kuvela izifo ezibangelwa kukujikeleza kunokukunceda wena nodokotela wakho wesikhumba niyiqonde kakuhle indlela ezixhomekeka ngayo kwihomoni.
PcosHormonalAcne.35: Imikhwa embalwa elula yokunyamekela inokukunceda ukunciphisa ukuqhambuka, ngaphandle kokuzicoca ngokupheleleyo:
PcosHormonalAcne.36: Hlamba ulusu lwakho ngobunono kusasa nangokuhlwa
PcosHormonalAcne.38: Khusela ulusu lwakho elangeni yonke imihla
PcosHormonalAcne.39: Kuphephe ukucinezela okanye ukukhetha xa kuphuma
PcosHormonalAcne.40: Kuxhomekeka kwimeko, ugqirha wesikhumba okanye ugqirha wezifo zesifazane usenokucebisa ukuba kusetyenziswe iindlela zonyango (iikhrimu, iigel) okanye, ukuba kuyimfuneko, unyango olulungeleyo lwehomoni.
PcosHormonalAcne.42: Unyango lwe-acne yehomoni (lokunxibelelana okanye lwehomoni) kufuneka lubhalwe kwaye lubhekiswe ngugqirha, ingakumbi ukuba unethemba lokukhulelwa.
PcosHormonalAcne.44: Iingcebiso zonyango ziluncedo ngokukhethekileyo kwiimeko ezithile:
PcosHormonalAcne.47: I-acne enzulu okanye i-acne eyonakalisa ngokukhawuleza
PcosHormonalAcne.51: I-acne yehomoni inesizathu esichaziweyo, esidibene neeandrogen.
PcosHormonalAcne.52: Ngokufuthi iba nefuthe kumzimba wangaphantsi wobuso yaye isenokuba mbi nangaphambi kokuya esikhathini.
PcosHormonalAcne.54: Ukunyamekela kakuhle nokunyanga ngendlela efanelekileyo kunokuyinyamekela.
PcosHormonalAcne.55: Ugqirha wesikhumba okanye ugqirha wezifo zesifazane unokukunceda ukuba uyaqhubeka usenza loo nto.
PcosHormonalAcne.57: Eli nqaku linikelwa ulwazi ngokubanzi kuphela yaye alithathi indawo yokuya kugqirha.

PcosIntro.105: Indlela yokunyamekela umntu ngamnye inceda ukuhlangabezana neemfuno zomfazi ngamnye.
PcosIntro.107: Eli nqaku limele libonise ulwazi ngokubanzi yaye alithathi indawo yokubonisana nogqirha.

PcosLifestyleManagement.6: Iindlela zokulawula i-PCOS, nemikhwa elula yokuxhasa ubomi bakho bemihla ngemihla.
PcosLifestyleManagement.18: Akukho kutya kungavumelekanga: Khangela ulungelelwaniso ngokubanzi kunokuba kubekho imithetho engqongqo
PcosLifestyleManagement.19: Akukho ndlela yodwa yokunyanga i-PCOS: unyango lunokwenziwa ngokwezibonakaliso zakho, izinto ozithandayo (umjikelo, ukuzala, ulusu, ubunzima) nemeko yakho.
PcosLifestyleManagement.20: Ukuziqeqesha rhoqo emzimbeni, nokuba kungokwengqiqo (ukuhamba ngokukhawuleza, ukukhwela ibhayisekile, ukuqeqesha amandla okulula), kunceda ukugcina ulungelelwaniso lweemvakalelo neendlela eziphilayo.
PcosLifestyleManagement.21: Ukulala ngokwaneleyo nokuchitha ixesha lokuphumla kunceda ukunciphisa impembelelo yoxinzelelo kwiimbopheleleko zehomoni, nto leyo enokuchaphazela iimpawu zePCOS.
PcosLifestyleManagement.23: Iinguqu ezincinane nezingunaphakade zidla ngokunceda ngaphezu kweenguqu ezinzima ukuzigcina.
PcosLifestyleManagement.24: Ukuphila nePCOS kunokuchaphazela isimo sakho sengqondo, ingakumbi ngenxa yeempawu ezibonakalayo okanye ukuxhalaba ngokuzala.
PcosLifestyleManagement.26: Intlungu enzulu okanye engaqhelekanga esithendeni, ukugalela igazi okunzulu okanye okude, ukudinwa ngokugqithiseleyo okanye ukunxanwa okungaqhelekanga okuqhubekayo, okanye ukubandezeleka ngokweemvakalelo okuya kuzinza ngokuhamba kwexesha.
PcosLifestyleManagement.28: I-PCOS ilawulwa imihla ngemihla ngemikhwa elula kunye nokulandelela rhoqo: naluphi na uhlengahlengiso oluncinane lubala, ngesantya sakho.

PcosMetabolism.6: Unxibelelwano phakathi kwePCOS, ubunzima, kunye nokumelana ne-insulin  ⁇  ngaphandle kokugweba okanye iindlela ezimfutshane.
PcosMetabolism.14: I-PCOS idla ngokubandakanyeka kutshintsho lwezinto eziphilayo, kuquka nokumelana ne-insulin.
PcosMetabolism.15: I-insulin yihormone enceda iiseli zisebenzise iglucose esegazini. Xa iiseli zingamelana ne-insulin, iiseli aziphenduli kakuhle kule hormone, yaye umzimba usenokuyihlawulela ngokuvelisa i-insulin engakumbi.
PcosMetabolism.16: Kwi-PCOS, oku kunokubangelwa kukwanda kwemveliso ye-androgen kwaye kunokubangela iimpawu ezithile.
PcosMetabolism.18: Uhlobo lwe-insulin olungafunekiyo lunokuhlolwa ngemifanekiso yegazi xa ugqirha ejonga ukuba lufanelekile.
PcosMetabolism.19: I-PCOS ithwaxa bonke abafazi, ukususela kumalungu amancinane ukuya kumalungu anzima.
PcosMetabolism.21: Ukulahlekelwa isisindo akusoloko kuyimfuneko okanye kwanele ngokwayo ukuphucula iimpawu.
PcosMetabolism.22: Ukulahlekelwa ubunzima okuncinane maxa wambi kunokuphucula amanqaku athile omjikelo okanye ukuhleleka komjikelo xa kukho ubunzima obungaphezulu.
PcosMetabolism.23: Injongo akuyonto yokulandela ubunzima obugqibeleleyo, kodwa kukuzakhela imikhwa engokoqobo nehlala ixesha elide. Ukutya okulinganiselayo, ukuhamba nokulala rhoqo kunokufaka isandla kwimpilo engcono yemetabolism.
PcosMetabolism.28: Ukulandelela kwe-PCOS akuphelelanga kumjikelo okanye kwiimpawu ze-hormonal. kuxhomekeka kwiprofayile yakho, umnikezeli wakho wezempilo usenokujonga amanqaku athile omjikelo ukuze akuncede ukuchonga izinto ezinokubangela umngcipheko kwangethuba.
PcosMetabolism.31: Ugqirha wakho usenokugqiba kwelokuba ahlole iimpawu ezithile ngokusekelwe kwiimpawu zakho, imbali yakho yempilo, imeko yentsapho yakho, nezinye izinto ezibangela umngcipheko.
PcosMetabolism.33: I-glucose yegazi kunye/okanye i-HbA1c, kuxhomekeke kumxholo
PcosMetabolism.35: Uxinzelelo lwegazi kunye nokuvavanywa komngcipheko we-cardiovascular
PcosMetabolism.36: Ukulandelela ubunzima kunye nomda womda, ngaphandle kokugweba
PcosMetabolism.38: Ezinye iinguqu zifanele zikhankanywe ngexesha lokucebisana, ingakumbi xa zintsha, ziqhubeka okanye zingaqhelekanga kuwe.
PcosMetabolism.42: Thetha nogqirha wakho ukuba ezi mpawu zivela ngendlela engaqhelekanga.
PcosMetabolism.44: Utshintsho olukhawulezileyo okanye olungachazwanga lufanele luvavanywe.
PcosMetabolism.46: Khawuchaze nayiphi na imbali yosapho yeswekile okanye yemibandela yemetabolism.
PcosMetabolism.48: Ukoma okungaqhelekanga, ukuchama kaninzi, ukudinwa okuqhubekayo, okanye utshintsho olubalulekileyo, olungachazwanga ubunzima kufuneka kuxelwe kugqirha.
PcosMetabolism.50: Ugqirha wakho usenokucebisa ukuba uyenze rhoqo le nkqubo kunokuba uyenze kanye, kuba injongo kukuhlolisisa indlela ophucula ngayo, ungajongi kuphela ubunzima.
PcosMetabolism.52: Ubunzima buyinxalenye nje enye yemibono yePCOS, kodwa indlela ebanzi yokujonga izinto ithatha ingqalelo imijikelo, iimpawu, indlela yokuphila, imbali yezonyango, kunye neempawu zendlela yokugaya izinto.
